title: CTAB-based Extraction of High Molecular Weight DNA from Sea Slugs
author: Jennifer H Wisecaver

steps.title: Prepare CTAB Stock Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare 100 mL of CTAB buffer using the following components:

substeps.instruction: 100 mL Ultrapure distilled water
1.576 g TrisHCL ph 8 (100 mM)
0.584 g EDTA (20 mM)
8.82 g NaCl (1.4 M)
10 mg Proteinase K (0.1 mg/mL)

steps.title: Prepare Equipment and Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the workspace and materials on the day of extraction:

substeps.instruction: Chill centrifuge to 4 °C
Obtain liquid nitrogen
Chill mortar and pestle in the -20 °C freezer
Bring Ampure beads to room temperature (~ 20 °C)
Prepare 5 mL of 70% Ethanol

steps.title: Prepare Working CTAB Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the working buffer per sample in a chemical fume hood:

substeps.instruction: Add 20 µL beta-mercaptoethanol (BME) to 10 mL CTAB buffer
Preheat the CTAB+BME buffer to 60 °C using a water bath

steps.title: Pulverize Sample
steps.instruction: Grind the sample (whole slug, partial slug, or dissected brain tissue) to a powder using a mortar, pestle, and liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Lysis and Incubation
steps.instruction: Perform initial lysis of the pulverized sample:

substeps.instruction: Transfer pulverized sample to a 50 mL centrifuge tube
Add 10 mL preheated CTAB+BME buffer
Incubate at 60 °C for 30 minutes

steps.title: Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Separate the DNA from proteins and lipids in a chemical fume hood:

substeps.instruction: Add 10 mL of chloroform:isoamyalcohol and mix well
Centrifuge at 7700 x g for 10 minutes
Transfer 2.5 mL of the aqueous phase to a 5 mL lo-bind microcentrifuge tube

steps.title: DNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the DNA from the aqueous phase:

substeps.instruction: Add 2/3 volume (1.7 mL) isopropanol
Gently invert the tube for 5 minutes at room temperature
Centrifuge at 10000 x g (time not specified) and discard the supernatant

steps.title: DNA Pellet Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the DNA pellet to remove contaminants:

substeps.instruction: Add 300 µL of 70% ethanol to the pellet
Use a pipette tip to dislodge the pellet from the tube wall
Centrifuge at 10000 x g for 5 minutes and discard the supernatant
Use a pipette to remove any remaining supernatant without disrupting the pellet

steps.title: Drying and Resuspension
steps.instruction: Dry the pellet and resuspend in buffer:

substeps.instruction: Lay the tube on its side with the cap open on a sterile surface and air dry for 10 minutes
Resuspend the pellet in 120 µL of TE buffer

steps.title: RNA Removal
steps.instruction: Treat the sample to remove RNA:

substeps.instruction: Add DNAase-free RNase A to a final concentration of 1 ug/mL
Incubate at 37 °C for 30 minutes

steps.title: Secondary Purification
steps.instruction: Perform a second phenol-chloroform extraction in a chemical fume hood:

substeps.instruction: Add 120 µL phenol:chloroform:isoamylalcohol
Centrifuge at 10000 x g for 10 minutes
Transfer 60 µL of the aqueous phase to a clean 1.5 mL lo-bind microcentrifuge tube and discard the remainder
Vortex Ampure beads to resuspend
Add 108 µL Ampure bead solution to the aqueous phase sample
Mix gently by pipetting up and down 10 times using a wide-bore pipette tip
Incubate at room temperature (20 °C) for 5 minutes
Place tube in a magnetic stand until the solution becomes clear (approx. 2 minutes)
Discard the clear supernatant while the tube is still in the stand

steps.title: Bead Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the beads to clean the DNA:

substeps.instruction: While in the magnetic stand, add 200 µL of 70% ethanol
Incubate for 30 seconds
Gently remove the clear supernatant
Repeat the wash step three times total
Remove all ethanol and leave the tube open to dry for 5 minutes (do not overdry to the point of cracking)

steps.title: DNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA from the beads:

substeps.instruction: Remove tube from magnetic stand and add 60 µL TE
Mix gently by pipetting up and down 10 times using a wide-bore pipette tip
Incubate at room temperature (20 °C) for 5 minutes
Place tube in magnetic stand until the solution becomes clear (approx. 1 minute)
Transfer the clear DNA suspension to a new tube and discard the old tube with beads

steps.title: Cleanup and Quality Control
steps.instruction: Finalize the process and assess DNA quality:

substeps.instruction: Dispose of all chloroform waste in the fume hood and wipe surfaces with 70-75% ethanol
Assess DNA integrity using the TapeStation
Measure DNA concentration using the Qubit

steps.title: Sample Storage
steps.instruction: Store high-quality DNA for sequencing if DIN ≥ 7 and concentration ≥ 20 ng/uL:

substeps.instruction: Tightly cap the tube
Label the cap and side vertically with a unique identifier (letter start, max 12 characters)
Wrap the cap with parafilm
Place sample in the 'Novogene' box in the full-sized -20 freezer
